quarterly_data.signal: GlobalWafers September 2026 consolidated revenue NT$51.29 hundred million, up 7.65% MoM and down 13.13% YoY. Q3 2026 consolidated revenue NT$148.71 hundred million, down 2.26% from Q2 and up 2.60% YoY; consolidated revenue for the first three quarters of 2026 NT$440.70 hundred million, down 4.40% YoY.
quarterly_data.figure: September NT$51.29 hundred million (+7.65% MoM, -13.13% YoY); Q3 NT$148.71 hundred million (-2.26% QoQ, +2.60% YoY); 9M NT$440.70 hundred million (-4.40% YoY)

quarterly_data.signal: GlobalWafers says expanding AI infrastructure investment and faster growth in HBM, advanced packaging, silicon photonics and high-efficiency power are strengthening the semiconductor recovery and extending it to memory, industrial and consumer electronics, lifting demand across all of its wafer-size product lines with capacity utilization staying high. The impact of the Novara (Italy) plant fire on customer supply has been effectively contained, but it will still affect overall revenue and capacity allocation in the short term: Novara partially resumed work on September 14, the epitaxial (EPI) process restarted and began shipping ahead of the wafering line, and recovery is ahead of the original expectation; some back-end processes are still being rebuilt, the supporting sites' capacity is relatively tight and some newly added equipment has long lead times and still needs installation, verification and customer qualification, so global room to reallocate capacity is limited and Novara's capacity and revenue contribution will recover step by step.
quarterly_data.figure: capacity utilization high; Novara partially restarted September 14

quarterly_data.signal: Site updates (GlobalWafers): the newly expanded 12-inch fab in Italy was not affected by the fire and customer qualification and mass-production ramp continue; the new Texas (U.S.) fab's shipment volume has risen significantly on customer qualification progress and a better product mix; demand for and output of 12-inch products at the Missouri SOI fab have risen sharply on demand from silicon photonics and other emerging applications; the Niigata (Japan) plant set a monthly revenue record in September and a quarterly revenue record in Q3, its third consecutive quarter of growth.
quarterly_data.figure: Niigata record monthly revenue in September and record Q3; Texas shipments significantly up

players.product: holding parent of GlobalWafers (46.64% stake; semiconductor wafers incl. 300mm reported through GlobalWafers), with its own solar silicon / cells and renewable-energy businesses

quarterly_data.signal: Sino-American Silicon (group release on the GlobalWafers site): September 2026 consolidated revenue NT$71.65 hundred million, up 6.67% MoM and down 5.61% YoY; Q3 2026 consolidated revenue NT$208.79 hundred million, down 1.14% from Q2 and up 9.41% YoY, which the company calls its second-highest for the period; revenue for the first three quarters NT$613.8 hundred million, a record for the period.
quarterly_data.figure: September NT$71.65 hundred million; Q3 NT$208.79 hundred million (+9.41% YoY); 9M NT$613.8 hundred million (record)

quarterly_data.signal: Sino-American Silicon renewable-energy business (group release): manufacturing through its wholly owned Yilan subsidiary (Taiwan rooftop solar, plus high-efficiency solar for U.S. zero-energy rooftops and low-earth-orbit satellites); its U.S. solar project with United Renewable Energy is progressing on plan; services through listed subsidiary 7931:TT. By the end of Q3 its two green-power retail companies had reached, in the company's words, the leading position in Taiwan's private green-power retail market; one of them signed a 20-year 26.3MW green-power purchase agreement with fishery-solar developer Tian Ying Clean Energy (romanised). Contracts of 10 years or longer are over 85% of the two retailers' green-power contracts, and cumulative contract value exceeds NT$1,000 hundred million.
quarterly_data.figure: 20-year 26.3MW green-power purchase agreement; long-term contracts over 85%; cumulative contract value over NT$1,000 hundred million

players.product: Electronic-grade disilane (Si2H6) and trisilane (Si3H8) CVD deposition gases and anhydrous hydrogen fluoride (AHF) dry-etch gas; through subsidiary Hong Jie Technology, ultra-high-purity cleaning and plasma-spray coating of CVD / etch equipment parts

quarterly_data.signal: Group affiliate Sino-American Silicon's release on Taiwan Speciality Chemicals: AI and advanced-process demand has pushed disilane capacity utilization close to full, with expansion continuing; anhydrous hydrogen fluoride (AHF) is gradually being introduced into advanced logic, memory and HBM processes; the benefits of the Hong Jie Technology acquisition are showing, with Hong Jie's cleaning and coating capacity expanding.
